summary: Frontend-only retest of the 2 reported bugs. BUG 1 (Stop button / vanishing Active Orders row) - FIXED & VERIFIED: with an in-flight job seeded in localStorage, the row + 4-step tracker + Stop button are present 600ms after a page reload and stay there (localStorage no longer wiped to '[]'), verified across 2 consecutive reloads; clicking Stop calls POST /create-and-release-order/{job_id}/cancel -> 200, button switches to 'Stopping...', NO 'Unknown job_id' toast. Cancel-removal path verified (job flipped to 'cancelled' in Mongo -> row removed + toast 'Order creation stopped by the user' + localStorage back to []). Stale/unknown job path verified (404 -> row removed + 'Lost track of this order' toast, no endless spinner). Full create flow also exercised end-to-end (product MAZ42117269, 3 Source-of-Supply options, site auto-set to P2, correct POST payload with logistic_relationship_uuid + production_model_uuid, success toast, form cleared, row with tracker + Stop) - the create POST was Playwright-intercepted and pointed at a synthetic Mongo job, so NO real SAP Production Proposal was created by this test pass. BUG 2 (Store Approval toast spam) - FIXED & VERIFIED: page left open ~75s across all 3 tabs (Pending Queue 7 rows, Journal 23 rows, Balance Pending genuinely empty - matches API) with ZERO toasts; injected failures confirm 2 consecutive poll failures are console-only/silent and the toast appears only on the 3rd consecutive failure. Synthetic auth session/user and both synthetic job docs were deleted after testing (DB verified clean).

minor.issue: cancel_requested is only honored inside the waiting_for_order loop in _run_create_and_release_job (server.py ~line 2460). If the user hits Stop while the job is in 'checking_stock'/'creating_proposal', the flag sits unread until (and only if) the job reaches that loop - the row stays on 'Stopping...' (button disabled) for as long as the stock check + proposal creation + SAP settle takes, and if the job instead pauses at 'waiting_store_approval'/'partial_pending_planner' the Stop is silently DISCARDED forever (paused rows render View/Confirm/Delete, never Stop again). Suggest checking cancel_requested at the top of each phase (stock check, proposal creation, and the resume/pause branches) so a Stop always terminates the job.

backend.err.log is flooded with 'Connection to my431827.businessbydesign.cloud.sap timed out (connect timeout=30)' for materialvaluationdata chunks (many per minute, 08:39-09:10). One user-facing GET /production-confirmation/source-of-supply-options/MAZ42117269 also returned a 502 during testing while direct curls of the same endpoint took only 1.8s - i.e. the aggressive background SAP refresh is the most likely real source of the 'transient blips' that produced the original Store Approval toast spam. Worth throttling/backing off the background refresh when SAP is unreachable.

ui_bugs.issue: The red warning 'This material has 3 valid Production Model/Site combinations - you must pick one before creating the order' stays visible (unchanged, still red/imperative) AFTER an option has been picked, so the form looks like it still has an error.

integration_issues.issue: stopTrackingJob() has no client-side deadline: once the POST succeeds the row is stuck on 'Stopping...' (button disabled) until the backend flips the job to 'cancelled'. Combined with the backend gap above, an early Stop or a Stop on a job that then pauses for store approval leaves the user with no way to stop/remove the row. Suggest a timeout after N poll ticks that drops the row locally with an explanatory toast.

pollFailureCountRef is never reset once it crosses 3, so during a longer outage a toast fires on EVERY subsequent 8s tick (spam returns, just delayed by 24s). The counter is also shared by all 3 loaders, so switching tabs during a flaky period can trip the threshold with fewer failures per endpoint than intended. Suggest resetting the counter after toasting (or toast only once per outage) and keying it per view.

issues: Source-of-Supply lookup only fires on blur of the Product ID field or on clicking a suggestion; typing a full valid ID and clicking 'Create Production Order' directly produced only the guard toast with no visible hint that the lookup hadn't run yet.
Requested End Date uses the browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere.

action_items: Honor cancel_requested in the checking_stock / creating_proposal / paused branches of the create-and-release job so Stop always terminates the run (currently only the waiting_for_order loop checks it).
Add a client-side deadline in stopTrackingJob() so a row can never sit on 'Stopping...' indefinitely.
Reset pollFailureCountRef after the toast fires (and/or make it per-view) so a long outage does not toast every 8s.
Clear/soften the red 'you must pick one' Source-of-Supply warning once an option is selected.
Throttle/back off the background SAP valuation refresh while SAP connects are timing out - it is flooding logs and is the likely cause of the user-facing transient 502s/poll blips.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionConfirmationPage.js: the lazy useState hydration + unconditional persist effect is correct and StrictMode-safe now; pollJob's pollingJobIdsRef guard prevents double polling on the dev double-invoke - verified live.
ProductionConfirmationPage.js is very large (>1250 lines with multiple tab components in one file) - split CreateOrderTab / ConfirmDialog / history tabs into separate modules.
StoreApprovalPage.js: the 3 loaders are near-identical (10+ duplicated lines each) - extract a single pollingLoader(url, setter, label) helper.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 2 fixes under test (6/6 scenarios passed)

seed_data_creation: Synthetic auth_users/auth_sessions doc (user 2a94b71e...:TEST-QA-106, page production_confirmation) + 2 synthetic background_jobs docs (statuses checking_stock / creating_proposal). ALL deleted after testing - verified 0 remaining TESTQA sessions/users/jobs and 0 TEST_ store_requests. No SAP write of any kind was performed.
test_credentials: No end-user login; used the documented synthetic Mongo session technique from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (cookie vms_session on the preview host) - worked as documented.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable helper: /app/backend/tests/_seed_active_job_106.py (seed|cancel|status|cleanup) creates a synthetic session + an in-flight create-and-release job doc so the Active Orders row/Stop/reload flows can be tested WITHOUT any SAP write. Note the create POST must be Playwright-intercepted (route.fulfill with the synthetic job_id) to avoid creating a real SAP Production Proposal. Both bugs of iteration_106 are fixed; the remaining open items are the backend cancel_requested phase coverage and the pollFailureCountRef reset. The historical planner_decision 'shortfall is None' TypeError did NOT recur in backend logs during this pass.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 root cause (activeJobs restore-effect race under React 18 StrictMode) is genuinely fixed by the lazy useState initializer - localStorage now keeps the seed across reloads (observed intact at t=0.6s and t=6.6s post-reload) and the row/Stop button render immediately. Bug 2 is fixed by the consecutive-failure counter: 1-2 transient poll failures are console-only, the 3rd consecutive one toasts. The underlying transient failures themselves are still occurring at the infrastructure level (SAP connect timeouts flooding the backend + an observed 502 on a user GET), which is now merely smoothed over, not eliminated.
